Universitaly Italiya ta'lim vazirliginin:
Universitaly is the single portal of the Italian Ministry of Education. Here you submit the pre-enrollment application for your chosen programme. The university checks and confirms it (validation), after which it goes to the embassy. Without a confirmed pre-enrollment you cannot apply for the visa.

Each university sets its own deadline. For example, in the 2026/27 academic year these deadlines ranged from 30 June to 15 September, depending on the university.

At some universities pre-acceptance and pre-enrollment happen in one step: once the university reviews and accepts your application, it also confirms the pre-enrollment on Universitaly or includes it in the admission process. Then you do not need to do anything separately. Check how your university works on its admission page or by email. Either way, to apply for the visa you must have a confirmed pre-enrollment in your name on Universitaly: check it in your Universitaly account.
